items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Papa Tio was supposed to be the greatest round yard at that time. But Lorenzo Tio came up afterwards, under him. The young Lorenzo? Yeah, he was young. He was just, oh, a couple years older than me.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear any of the Tio's say where they came from, if they might have been Mexican, or if they French or Spanish, or where they might have come from?

Well, the Tio's, well, I'm going to tell you. I'm most part of it, they sort of, could be Mexican or something like that, the type he was, you understand. They could be Mexican or they could be French.
Yeah. You never heard anyone say if they came from Mexico, if they were educated?

items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: Lorenzo Tio came up afterwards, under him. The young Lorenzo? Yeah, he was young. He was just, oh, a couple years older than me.

ctx.x: Which was the best one of the family? Who was the best clarinetist, do you think, of all the Tio's?

Oh, well, Papa Tio was supposed to be the greatest round yard at that time. But Lorenzo Tio came up afterwards, under him. The young Lorenzo? Yeah, he was young. He was just, oh, a couple years older than me.
